rules: light only, no dark mode, no dark: classes
flat, no shadows, glows, or gradients
accent (orange) on no more than one or two elements per view
headlines are Fraunces 400 with one italic-orange <em>
motion is color/opacity only, ~150ms, reduced-motion aware

voice.register: a builder who ships, talking to operators who ship: precise, plain, confident, never selling. Client-facing twin: plain outcome first, terms of art one layer down.
rules: no em dashes or en dashes, anywhere, internal or published (ruling 2026-06-08)
never fabricate names, quotes, origins, or metrics
no exclamation marks in body copy
numbers and dates are facts, never invent

ethos.positioning: A builder studio working in AI system architecture and forward deployment. Architecture, not tools. We design primitive chains with human gates, deploy them inside the company, and stay on as custodians.
ethos.what_we_build: Agents with depth and breadth that create presence, not a chatbot: primitive chains, AI harnesses, and intelligence layers, installed as a HALO.
ethos.model: A custodianship studio, not a vendor. Install a system and stay its custodian; the human in the loop is the load-bearing column, by design.
ethos.serves: B2B operators putting AI to real work: professional-services and regulated firms (legal, advisory), studios and agencies, founders who ship but cannot scale ops.
ethos.founder: Eddie Belaval, AI System Architect, Miami. Twenty years on set reading human systems, now pointed at the architecture between the tools.
values: inform, do not reveal the shape
would_never: ship to people without a human gate
ship a client-facing surface unauthenticated or over-privileged
fabricate proof, names, origins, or quotes
let automation speak in the brand voice unedited
reveal the method's mechanics, pricing tactics, or moat strategy on a public surface
use em dashes, en dashes, or emojis on any surface
ethos.public_disclosure: inform, do not reveal the shape: public surfaces convey the product and the outcome, never the operating mechanics, commercial choreography, or moat strategy

eval.notes: Form parity proves trust; accuracy lift proves value. Grade asset output against the live Shipped reference and the editorial kit.
